mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_scheduler_lock (lock_key, owner, locked_until) VALUES (#{lockKey}, #{owner}, clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds})) ON CONFLICT (lock_key) WHERE deleted = false DO UPDATE SET owner = EXCLUDED.owner, locked_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), update_time = clock_timestamp(), version = sys_scheduler_lock.version + 1 WHERE sys_scheduler_lock.locked_until <= clock_timestamp() OR sys_scheduler_lock.owner = EXCLUDED.owner
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_scheduler_lock SET locked_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), update_time = clock_timestamp(), version = version + 1 WHERE lock_key = #{lockKey} AND owner = #{owner} AND deleted = false AND locked_until > clock_timestamp()
UPDATE sys_scheduler_lock SET locked_until = clock_timestamp(), update_time = clock_timestamp(), version = version + 1 WHERE lock_key = #{lockKey} AND owner = #{owner} AND deleted = false
